metadata.title: The Hierarchical Distribution of the Young Stellar Clusters in Six Local Star Forming Galaxies

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies extragalactic star clusters and stellar associations in six galaxies (T:p1-b4; T:p6-b5; T:p17-b8), not individual Galactic stars. Its references to gravitationally unbound class 3 associations describe associations within the target galaxies, not stars unbound from the Milky Way, and no Milky Way unbound candidacy is established for any object.
